title: fix(app-shell): name the language menu's built-in locales from the platform locale table
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoTqGm7tGbVDuaZP77QrQG36)_
Fixes #31045

domain:ui#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzTyA5TRApD5ko4rtq

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台语言菜单里内置语言的名称，改为直接读平台语言表 `PLATFORM_LOCALES` 每行的 `label`（如 简体中文、繁體中文、Português (Brasil)），删掉 `LocaleSwitcher` 里按旧代码 `zh`/`pt` 手写的第二份名称表。
- 为什么改：#30902 把语言包改成按表标签（`zh-Hans`、`zh-Hant`、`pt-BR`）之后，手写表对不上这三个标签，它们的名称落到浏览器的 `Intl.DisplayNames`，随浏览器与 ICU 版本变化，缺 `Intl.DisplayNames` 的运行时直接显示裸代码 `zh-Hans`。
- 风险与回滚：菜单提供哪些语言不变，只改名称来源。在 Node 22（ICU 78.3）和 Chromium 153 上，11 个名称改前改后逐字相同；变化只出现在 CLDR 不同或缺 `Intl.DisplayNames` 的运行时。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/LocaleSwitcher.tsx` 的 `BUILT_IN_LABEL_BY_TAG` 与 `localeLabel`；`LocaleSwitcher.appLocales.test.tsx` 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/LocaleSwitcher.appLocales.test.tsx`，预期 12 个测试全绿；把手写表放回去重跑，预期「without Intl.DisplayNames」一例转红，点名 `zh-Hans`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- **席位意见**：ui 席 2 对照 head `fe26b46f` 的 diff 复核：3 个文件、+87 / −39，无受治理路径。语言菜单的内置语言名改由平台语言表 `PLATFORM_LOCALES` 的 `label` 提供（如 简体中文、繁體中文、Português (Brasil)），删去按旧 `zh`/`pt` 代码手写的名单；表外代码仍走 `Intl.DisplayNames`，菜单提供哪些语言不变。新测试含「没有 Intl.DisplayNames」一档，恢复手写名单即红。CI 全绿，Clause-② no，不欠契约复审。同意落地。

## What changes

- `localeLabel()` names a platform locale table tag by its row's `label`. The lookup is a `Map` built from `PLATFORM_LOCALES` (`tag` → `label`), so a code like `constructor` or `__proto__` still cannot pick up a label. `BUILT_IN_LABELS`, the hand list keyed by the old ten codes (`zh`, `pt` among them), is deleted; there is no second list of names.
- `Intl.DisplayNames` stays the fallback for every code that is not a table tag (an app-shipped `th`, or a bare `zh` / `pt` an app might still list), with the same capitalization and the same degradation to the bare code.
- The docblocks no longer call `pt-BR` an app-shipped locale and say where the built-in names come from.
- `@objectstack/spec` was already a dependency of `@object-ui/app-shell` (`useUserLocale.ts` imports `@objectstack/spec/system`), so no manifest or lockfile change.
- Root changeset `.changeset/31045-locale-switcher-table-labels.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

The menu's option set is not touched (that is #30514, phase 4). #30514's body carries no separate "drop the dead `zh` / `pt` rows" line; the dead `zh` and `pt` label rows that PR #30902's acceptance notes pointed at ("Its hand-kept names are keyed `zh` and `pt`") are removed here, so nothing of that remains for #30514.

## Tests

`LocaleSwitcher.appLocales.test.tsx` (the existing harness file, new top-level describe):

- every `PLATFORM_LOCALES` row's `label` is what `localeLabel(tag)` returns;
- the same with `Intl.DisplayNames` removed from the runtime (and an app code such as `th` still degrades to the bare code);
- `constructor` and `__proto__` answer the bare code.

The fixtures that modelled an app shipping the retired `zh` tag and expected the hand list's `中文` now ship `zh-Hans` and expect the table's `简体中文`. The phantom-label comment no longer says `pt-BR` is named by `Intl.DisplayNames`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise, measured.** The structural defect holds on `main@115a43ad`: the three tags missed the hand list and were named by the runtime. The visible names did not differ on the two runtimes measured (Node v22.23.4 with ICU 78.3, Chromium 153.0.8010.12): there CLDR happens to give the table's strings after capitalization. They differ where `Intl.DisplayNames` is missing (bare `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`, `pt-BR`) and on any runtime whose CLDR names them otherwise. Table below.
- **Ablation direction.** With the hand list restored, the runtime-Intl leg of the new pins stays green on Node 22 / ICU 78.3 (CLDR coincides), and the no-`Intl.DisplayNames` leg goes red. That leg is the one that proves the name comes from the table.
- **ProfilePage comment.** `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ProfilePage.tsx`'s `nativeLanguageName` docblock still mentions app-shell's "hand-kept `BUILT_IN_LABELS` map". It is outside this card's file surface and is left alone; the profile page's language card names `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant` and `pt-BR` through `Intl.DisplayNames`, the same runtime dependence this PR removes from the menu, because `localeLabel` is not on the `@object-ui/app-shell` entry. Noted for the seat; not filed.

## Verification

<details>
<summary>Before / after label table (Node v22.23.4, ICU 78.3; base 115a43ad, head fe26b46f)</summary>

| tag | table `label` | before | before, no `Intl.DisplayNames` | after | after, no `Intl.DisplayNames` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| en | English | English | English | English | English |
| zh-Hans | 简体中文 | 简体中文 | zh-Hans | 简体中文 | 简体中文 |
| zh-Hant | 繁體中文 | 繁體中文 | zh-Hant | 繁體中文 | 繁體中文 |
| es | Español | Español | Español | Español | Español |
| ar | العربية | العربية | العربية | العربية | العربية |
| fr | Français | Français | Français | Français | Français |
| pt-BR | Português (Brasil) | Português (Brasil) | pt-BR | Português (Brasil) | Português (Brasil) |
| ru | Русский | Русский | Русский | Русский | Русский |
| de | Deutsch | Deutsch | Deutsch | Deutsch | Deutsch |
| ja | 日本語 | 日本語 | 日本語 | 日本語 | 日本語 |
| ko | 한국어 | 한국어 | 한국어 | 한국어 | 한국어 |

Off-table codes, before → after: `zh` 中文 → 中文, `pt` Português → Português, `th` ไทย → ไทย (all through `Intl.DisplayNames` after).

Chromium 153.0.8010.12 raw `Intl.DisplayNames([tag]).of(tag)`: zh-Hans 简体中文, zh-Hant 繁體中文, pt-BR português (Brasil) (capitalized by `localeLabel`).

</details>

<details>
<summary>Ablation (head fe26b46f)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the `PLATFORM_LOCALES.map(...)` initializer with the deleted ten-row hand list (anchor 1 → 0, blob dfc65564 → 7b64fa58) and ran the appLocales file: 1 failed / 11 passed, `zh-Hans: expected 'zh-Hans' to be '简体中文'` in "names every table tag with its row label on a runtime without Intl.DisplayNames". Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports the component by relative source path, so no build leg applies.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Suites, type-check and gates (head fe26b46f)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/layout/ packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/userLocale-10059.test.tsx`: 141 files, 938 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0.
- eslint on the two changed sources: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 36 derived families, all exit 0, including `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, `pnpm check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `pnpm check:test-source-alias` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (170 files passed, 2 skipped). `--ran`: 36 derived, 36 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Change set: 3 files, +87 / -39.

</details>
